definitions.explanation: food preserved in sake kasu (the solid residue from sake brewing)

notes:
ABOUT SAKE KASU:
⟦{酒粕|さけかす}→酒粕：14773_sakekasu⟧ is the solid residue left after pressing sake. It has a mild alcoholic content and a distinctive sweet, fermented flavor.

COMMON ITEMS:
- ⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粕漬|かすづ}け (fish pickled in sake lees - often grilled)
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粕漬|かすづ}け (vegetables in sake lees)
- {奈良漬|ならづ}け (a famous type of vegetable kasuzuke)

FLAVOR:
{粕漬|かすづ}け has a distinctive sweet and savory flavor with subtle alcoholic notes. Fish prepared this way is often called {西京漬|さいきょうづ}け when made with white miso and sake lees.
